vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come from Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml), which also reads the lockfile; a second PR from Renovate would duplicate it.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh the lockfile once a month in one PR, so indirect packages do not drift far behind.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: npm packages can be unpublished within 72 hours and hijacked releases surface in the first days, so the dashboard offers the newest version that is at least 3 days old.
Patch and minor updates arrive together once a week and go in when the PR checks pass. Majors stay on the dashboard until approved.
The lint plugin is young; each release may add findings, so bump it weekly in its own PR and let the CI lint job show the effect.
Actions are pinned to commit SHAs, which nobody can read well enough to approve from the dashboard.
